annotations.title: The companies hiring most right now, with trends and pay

description: The companies hiring most right now, with trends and pay. For "who's hiring the most data people in the UK?", "which companies are growing?", "who's hiring remotely?". Ranks employers in Job Spotter's index by open roles, each with roles added and taken down this week, its trend (growing, steady or contracting), the change on the week before, median advertised pay, AI roles, its careers page and any US layoff notices in the last 90 days. Then call search_jobs with the company name for its roles. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.

country.description: Optional country by name or two-letter code, for example United Kingdom, US or DE. Leave out for worldwide.

function.description: Optional job area: software, data (data and AI), design, product, sales, finance, marketing, customer, healthcare, education, people, legal, operations, hardware, service or management. A job word such as "nurse" works too.

where.description: Optional town or city (for example London or Austin), or remote.
